english: Consumes one Boar Summoning Rune to call a weak allied Forest boar for 60 seconds. One per caster; recasting replaces it. Find open ground outside trader protection. Follows you and fights nearby enemies. Combat raises Summoning proficiency: +2 health per rank and +1 damage per 10 ranks. Rod quality adds 10% health and damage per quality above one. Craft at a Field Crafting Mat. Uses a borrowed wooden casting-focus model. Repair with Focus Repair Supplies.

Ammunition for the Forest Summoning Rod. One rune calls one boar for 60 seconds. No loot or harvest from summons. Craft five from 10 stone, 5 bone and 2 chrysanthemum at a Field Crafting Mat or Rune Bench.
